note: Second pass at Reel 3's music. The first (2026-10-06_reel3_score_beat.json) matched the wallpaper reel's tempo, rhythm and steadiness but measured darker than it (tone x0.73 against a limit of 0.75 to 1.33), so the final reference check failed. Same structure, with a brighter, more present top end asked for in the style. The feel still comes from the wallpaper reel's separated music stem via score_music --reference-features.
global: beat-driven instrumental bed; deep sub bass with a clearly audible mid-range; kick on the beat; crisp bright hi-hats and percussion; a present plucked or synth mid-range riff; consistent energy with no breakdowns; no vocals
avoid: vocals; lyrics; acoustic guitar; orchestral; cinematic trailer hits; risers; muffled or dark mix; cheesy corporate

sections.name: Hit
sections.style: starts on one strong accented downbeat hit with a deep bass note; then the beat settles in

sections.name: Groove
sections.style: steady drum and bass groove; kick on every beat; busy bright hi-hats; a repeating mid-range riff; deep sub bass line; same energy throughout

sections.name: Resolve
sections.style: drums stop; one final accented bass hit on the first beat that rings out and ends cleanly
